outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph, not a plot; check does not apply.
Panel B is a micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot; check does not apply.

Panel C contains a box plot (which itself shows distribution and is exempt) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per genotype/diameter category. The 3D bar chart shows only aggregated bars with no individual data points overlaid, despite representing means across n=8–18 mice per genotype.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type that is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels (with error bars shown), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not plots; check does not apply.
Panel G includes a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars, but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
